_comment: The reading assistant, as it was deployed. This is the agent c-02 and d-02 run.
d-02's deliberate failure is in this file, and it is the shape of a real one: nothing here
is a typo. Whoever set the agent up started from the reading path, where the agent reads
meter data, and changed the tools without changing the two lines that say which door the
agent knocks on and what it asks for. Both still describe the reading path. Read the
token_exchange block against the work order API's own protected resource metadata at
Nothing in c-02 refuses it, because the policy c-02 runs decides on the tool name and logs
whatever identity the call happens to carry. d-02 activates a policy that does not.
